items.title: Tyner McCoy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He was the first guy to encourage me to record on my own, Bob Thiele, he was a nice guy.

ctx.x: Bobby was with Art, that’s when he did “Dat Dere, all those tunes he wrote. I like composing myself and that’s one thing John gave me the opportunity to do that. And then I was recording with Bob Thiele, he said, “This is a good time for you to do your own recordings”. He
had been recording John’s quartet. He was the first guy to encourage me to record on my own, Bob Thiele, he was a nice guy.
So when you join John’s band, you already know Jimmy Garrison.
